edit.description: provisioning pins core.longpaths ahead of `worktree add`

summary: `core.longpaths` is pinned by `job new` alone, so on win32 nothing pins it before the first worktree path deep enough to need it — and the verb is cut

notes: `pinLongPaths` (`src/git.ts`) holds the win32 guard and the idempotent read itself, so the call site is unconditional and the case is decidable off win32 — a win32-only test would skip on the default lane and read green on the base. `jobNew` is its only caller today; THE-JOB-VERBS-AND-CHAIN-SEEDDIR-ARE-CUT removes that one, so this lands first.
